name: gsearch-agent-pack
module_installation: Install the complete root folder; child modules rely on shared relative references.

modules.name: gsearch-audit
modules.title: Run a source-backed SEO audit
modules.description: Use for a full-site SEO audit, launch-readiness review or prioritised remediation plan; route narrower questions to the specialist skill instead.

modules.name: gsearch-essentials
modules.title: Explain and check Search eligibility
modules.description: Use when a user asks how Google Search works, why a website is not eligible or what the minimum technical requirements are.

modules.name: gsearch-spam-policy
modules.title: Review a proposal against Search spam policies
modules.description: Use to review link acquisition, scaled publishing, third-party hosting, redirects or search-manipulation proposals for policy compliance.

modules.name: gsearch-content-quality
modules.title: Evaluate usefulness, reliability and review quality
modules.description: Use for a content-quality audit, a product-review improvement plan or an assessment of whether a page adds value for its intended reader.

modules.name: gsearch-content-brief
modules.title: Plan a useful page and its editorial brief
modules.description: Use to plan a new page, consolidate overlapping pages or build a topic-level content brief from a defined audience need.

modules.name: gsearch-ai-content
modules.title: Govern AI-assisted content production
modules.description: Use when generating or reviewing AI-assisted text, images, metadata or large content batches for a website.

modules.name: gsearch-ai-visibility
modules.title: Diagnose visibility in Google AI search
modules.description: Use for AI Overviews, AI Mode, generative Search participation, AI-search content strategy or questions about LLMS.txt.

modules.name: gsearch-internal-links
modules.title: Audit internal discovery and link semantics
modules.description: Use for orphan pages, navigation redesign, internal-link improvements or review of paid and user-generated link attributes.

modules.name: gsearch-url-architecture
modules.title: Design URL, facet and pagination behavior
modules.description: Use for URL structure, category architecture, filters, faceted navigation, infinite scroll, pagination or crawl-space explosions.

modules.name: gsearch-robots
modules.title: Review robots.txt safely
modules.description: Use to inspect robots.txt, diagnose crawl blocking or propose crawl-access rules; not to remove confidential content from public access.

modules.name: gsearch-index-controls
modules.title: Choose indexing and preview controls
modules.description: Use for noindex, X-Robots-Tag, nosnippet, max-snippet, data-nosnippet or conflicts between crawl and indexing directives.

modules.name: gsearch-sitemaps
modules.title: Build and validate a sitemap plan
modules.description: Use to create, inspect, split or troubleshoot XML sitemaps and sitemap indexes.

modules.name: gsearch-canonicals
modules.title: Resolve duplicate and canonical signals
modules.description: Use for duplicate URLs, alternate versions, conflicting canonicals or Google selecting a different canonical.

modules.name: gsearch-http-redirects
modules.title: Diagnose responses, redirects and soft 404s
modules.description: Use for HTTP errors, redirect chains, soft 404s, intermittent server failures or technical response-policy design.

modules.name: gsearch-crawl-budget
modules.title: Investigate crawl efficiency with evidence
modules.description: Use for large or rapidly changing sites with suspected crawling bottlenecks, excessive duplicate crawling or slow discovery of important updates.

modules.name: gsearch-crawler-verification
modules.title: Verify crawler identity in supplied logs
modules.description: Use when interpreting server logs attributed to Google crawlers or assessing whether a user-agent string is trustworthy.

modules.name: gsearch-javascript
modules.title: Audit JavaScript rendering and discovery
modules.description: Use for client-rendered sites, single-page applications, missing rendered content, hydration issues or JavaScript-generated metadata.

modules.name: gsearch-mobile
modules.title: Verify mobile content and indexing parity
modules.description: Use when a mobile redesign, responsive layout, separate mobile URL or hidden mobile content might affect Search.

modules.name: gsearch-migration
modules.title: Plan and verify a URL migration
modules.description: Use for domain moves, URL restructures, protocol changes or a launch that changes existing indexable URLs.

modules.name: gsearch-removal
modules.title: Choose durable removal and privacy controls
modules.description: Use when removing a page from Search, hiding sensitive information, handling stale results or assessing a temporary removal request.

modules.name: gsearch-titles-snippets
modules.title: Improve titles and snippets without false guarantees
modules.description: Use to review page titles, visible headings, meta descriptions or controls affecting search snippets.

modules.name: gsearch-brand-appearance
modules.title: Review site identity, favicon and breadcrumbs
modules.description: Use for site names, homepage organization identity, favicons or breadcrumb appearance.

modules.name: gsearch-images
modules.title: Audit image discovery and usefulness
modules.description: Use for image SEO, image accessibility, missing image search visibility or media metadata review.

modules.name: gsearch-video
modules.title: Diagnose video page and feature eligibility
modules.description: Use for video indexing, watch-page design, thumbnails, VideoObject planning or live-broadcast indexing questions.

modules.name: gsearch-page-experience
modules.title: Turn experience measurements into a repair plan
modules.description: Use for Core Web Vitals, speed diagnostics, intrusive layout issues or questions about performance and Search.

modules.name: gsearch-structured-data
modules.title: Implement structured data through eligibility gates
modules.description: Use for JSON-LD, Microdata or RDFa creation, schema review, rich-result errors or decisions about which markup belongs on a page.

modules.name: gsearch-products
modules.title: Model product, offer and variant information
modules.description: Use for product snippets, merchant listings, ProductGroup variants, offers, prices, availability or product-review markup.

modules.name: gsearch-ecommerce
modules.title: Design an ecommerce discovery and launch plan
modules.description: Use for category/product architecture, catalogue launch readiness, inventory discoverability or a broad ecommerce SEO plan.

modules.name: gsearch-publishing
modules.title: Review article, Discover and preferred-source readiness
modules.description: Use for publisher SEO, article metadata, Discover readiness or preferred-source implementation.

modules.name: gsearch-local
modules.title: Review local-business website representation
modules.description: Use for LocalBusiness markup, multi-location website structure or consistency of local business facts on a website.

modules.name: gsearch-international
modules.title: Design language and regional alternates
modules.description: Use for hreflang, multi-language sites, regional URLs, language redirects or conflicting locale canonicalization.

modules.name: gsearch-paywalls
modules.title: Represent subscription content without exposing it
modules.description: Use for paywalled articles, subscription markup, access-state representation or Search visibility of protected publisher content.

modules.name: gsearch-ugc
modules.title: Review forums, Q&A and profile content
modules.description: Use for discussion forums, user-answer questions, creator profiles, review communities or prevention of user-generated spam.

modules.name: gsearch-feature-resolver
modules.title: Resolve any current Search feature before implementation
modules.description: Use for a specialised rich result or Search feature not fully specified by another module, including jobs, events, recipes, courses, datasets, software and regional experiences.

modules.name: gsearch-search-console
modules.title: Build an authorised Search monitoring view
modules.description: Use for Search Console report interpretation, monitoring setup, indexing/performance questions or analysis of supplied report exports.

modules.name: gsearch-traffic-drop
modules.title: Diagnose a traffic change without jumping to causes
modules.description: Use for sudden or gradual losses in Search clicks, impressions, indexed pages or a particular search surface.

modules.name: gsearch-ranking-updates
modules.title: Interpret ranking systems and update timing
modules.description: Use for questions about core updates, ranking-system concepts, suspected ranking factors or update-related evaluation.

modules.name: gsearch-search-operators
modules.title: Use search operators as limited diagnostic evidence
modules.description: Use for site: checks, public search spot checks or questions about whether an operator proves a page is indexed.

modules.name: gsearch-special-cases
modules.title: Resolve regional, AMP and special-content boundaries
modules.description: Use when a request depends on region-limited Search features, AMP serving behavior, explicit-content classification or a speciality not covered by standard SEO checks.

modules.name: gsearch-experiments
modules.title: Design an interpretable SEO experiment
modules.description: Use for metadata tests, template experiments, A/B testing or evaluation of an SEO change.

modules.name: gsearch-review
modules.title: Independently review an SEO deliverable or patch
modules.description: Use before final delivery of any audit, recommendation, generated markup, code patch or claimed completed implementation.

modules.name: gsearch-docs-refresh
modules.title: Refresh the documentation evidence without silent rule changes
modules.description: Use to update this skill pack, resolve a source conflict, verify a volatile requirement or recheck deprecated features.

modules.name: gsearch-tutor
modules.title: Teach Google Search concepts from first principles
modules.description: Use when the user asks to learn SEO, explain a specific Search mechanism or practise diagnosing a website rather than requesting production changes.

modules.name: gsearch-handoff
modules.title: Preserve task state for another agent or session
modules.description: Use when pausing, resuming or transferring an SEO task between agents, tools or sessions.
